res_delivered: Fetched by Home Assistant, waiting for the result
res_failed: Home Assistant could not do it
res_ignored_unmapped: Ignored: no scene is linked to this action in Home Assistant
res_ignored_disabled: Ignored: the switch is off in Home Assistant
res_ignored_expired: Ignored: reached Home Assistant too late
res_refused_offline: Refused: Home Assistant was not connected
res_refused_busy: Refused: too many requests at once
res_refused_not_paired: Refused: Home Assistant is not paired
why_number: phone number or long run of digits
ev_pair_locked: Pairing code cancelled after 5 wrong tries
test_not_paired: Home Assistant is not paired yet: follow the 3 steps above.
test_offline: Home Assistant is not connected right now. Check that it is on and online.
test_busy: Too many orders waiting: try again in a moment.
test_unknown_key: Write an action such as lights:red or tts:read (lowercase letters, digits, colon).
test_blocked: This text would be refused just as for a viewer: {why}.
test_rate: Easy: one test every 3 seconds, 30 per hour. Try again in {seconds} s.
st_unpaired: Home Assistant is not paired yet. Follow the 3 steps below.
st_cut: Everything is cut. Nothing is sent to Home Assistant and viewers get their points back. ({by}, {when})
st_connected: Home Assistant is connected ({name}, last sign of life: {when}).
st_lost: Home Assistant has not been seen since {when}. Check that it is on and online.
st_never: Paired {when}, but Home Assistant has not connected yet. Check that the Curiosa integration is installed.
live_yes: **Live:** Twitch says you are live. Viewers can trigger actions.
live_grace: **Live:** the stream is over, but the door stays open {minutes} minutes to finish what is in progress.
live_no: **Live:** you are not live (neither on Twitch nor on YouTube, depending on the channels installed). Viewers' actions are refused and their points given back (the test button still works).
live_unknown: **Live:** Twitch or YouTube is not answering right now. To be safe, nothing is played until we know whether you are live.
live_none: **Live:** we cannot tell whether you are live. Without it, nothing is played for viewers, to be safe. Install “My Twitch channel” or “YouTube channel”.
live_reason: tells whether you are live on Twitch
big_no_right: You are not allowed to cut everything. Ask the person who manages the site.
big_resume_no_right: Everything is cut. Only a person who manages Home Assistant can resume.
done_stop: Everything is cut. Nothing is sent to Home Assistant any more.
done_start: Resumed. Viewers' actions start again when you are live.
done_test: Test sent: follow it right below.
wiz_1: **1. Install the integration** in Home Assistant with HACS: add this repository, then install “Curiosa”: {repo}
wiz_2: **2. Copy the 8-character code.** Home Assistant asks for your site's address and this code.
wiz_code_help: The code works only once and stays valid for {minutes} more min.
wiz_3: **3. That's all.** This page will show “Home Assistant is connected” as soon as it has the code.
dev_unpair_confirm: Unpair Home Assistant? It will receive nothing any more and whatever is waiting will be refused.
dev_another_help: The new device takes the place of the previous one as soon as it uses the code: the previous one receives nothing any more.
test_help: Simulates a channel points reward, without touching Twitch or YouTube: no point is taken or given back. The text goes through the same moderation as a viewer's. Works outside a live too.
test_key_help: Actions already received are offered here.
test_text: Text to read (for actions starting with tts)
test_text_help: {max} characters at most. Example: Hello everyone
fol_sent: Sent: the action {key} is in the queue
fol_waiting_fetch: Waiting for Home Assistant to fetch it…
fol_live: This page updates by itself for 60 seconds.
jr_empty: Nothing yet. Viewers' actions will appear here with their outcome.
jr_note: The last 50 lines, kept for 7 days. A refused message is not kept: only the reason.
words_intro: **Refused words:** {count} words or phrases are watched right now (accents, capitals and digits slipped into words do not fool the list). Complete or correct it below.
live_yes_youtube: **Live:** YouTube says you are live. Viewers can trigger actions.
live_yes_both: **Live:** Twitch and YouTube both say you are live. Viewers can trigger actions.
live_reason_youtube: tells whether you are live on YouTube
